title: Variational Mixtures and Multi-Marginal Flow Matching: Advancing Statistical Inference with Biological Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.36911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this thesis I develop methods for statistical inference when the distributions arising from complex biological systems are multi-modal, geometrically structured, and sometimes only defined up to a normalizing constant. I start from variational inference and, when analytic update equations are unavailable, move to black-box variational inference. To build intuition regarding inference challenges and the proposed methodologies, I introduce a novel unnormalized target density (the CoLN distribution) and reuse it as a controlled test case in the kappa. I then trace a trajectory of increasingly expressive approximations: ensembles evaluated with the multiple importance sampling ELBO (Paper A) and variational mixtures that automate component cooperation and exploration (Paper B). translated_title: 变分混合与多边缘流匹配：推进生物应用中的统计推断
translated_abstract: 在这篇学位论文中，我针对复杂数学生物系统所产生的分布是多峰、具有几何结构、且有时仅定义到归一化常数（即非归一化分布）的情形，开发了相应的统计推断方法。我从变分推断出发，当解析更新方程不可用时，转向黑盒变分推断。为了建立对推断挑战及所提方法的直观理解，我引入了一种新颖的非归一化目标密度（CoLN 分布），并在 kappa 中将其重用为受控测试用例。随后，我沿着表达能力不断增强的近似方法展开：包括使用多重重要性采样 ELBO 进行评估的集成方法（论文 A），以及能够自动实现各分量协作与探索的变分混合方法（论文 B）。由于表达能力的提升伴随着计算代价，我提出了高效的混合学习思路，包括蒙特卡洛目标估计器，以便更高效地扩展混合学习方法。
tldr: 该论文提出变分混合与多边缘流匹配等表达能力更强的统计推断方法，以应对复杂生物系统中多峰、几何结构化且仅有非归一化形式分布带来的推断挑战，并通过蒙特卡洛目标估计器等手段提升混合学习的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This thesis advances statistical inference for multi-modal, geometrically structured, and unnormalized distributions arising in complex biological systems by developing variational mixtures, multi-marginal flow matching, and efficient Monte Carlo-based mixture learning methods.
